digest.component_or_area: review_kernel verification telemetry and plan_review/code_review pipelines
propositions: contract_violations sink exists only in plan_review/orchestrator.py as a ContextVar and is not wired into code_review_decide or finalize_code_review_verdict

outcome_counts telemetry (clean/recovered/empty_outcomes/unrecoverable) from verify_findings() is available in unit tests but not surfaced to either plan_review_decide or code_review_decide at the merged boundary
code_review_decide currently logs contract violations via logger.error instead of recording them to a structured sink like plan_review does
both pipelines call reshape_verifications() and check has_violations but only plan_review propagates violation data into coverage
a shared contract_violations sink and a shared decide_outcome_counts helper must be moved into review_kernel and imported by both pipelines to eliminate duplication and ensure consistent telemetry
